content_sections.body: Practise the alphabet in groups: A–G, H–N, O–U, V–Z. Notice easily confused letter names such as A/E, G/J, and M/N.
content_sections.title: The alphabet

content_sections.body:
An: My name is An.
Leo: How do you spell that?
An: A-N.
Leo: Thank you.
content_sections.title: How do you spell it?

exercises.prompt: Match each name to its spelling.

items.explanation: Spell asks for the letters in a word or name.

exercises.prompt: Say your first name, then spell it letter by letter.
exercises.rubric: Says a complete name sentence.; Gives the letters in the correct order.; Separates the letter names clearly enough to follow.

objectives: Recognize and say the English alphabet in useful groups.
Ask for and give the spelling of a name.

constraints: Use a name of two to five letters.
Do not use external audio or text.
listening.goal: Practise the listening target for this lesson.
listening.instruction: Read an original exchange in which a speaker spells one short name. Hide the exchange and ask the learner to choose the correct spelling from three options. Reveal it after the answer.

constraints: If no learner audio is available, provide models only and state NOT_ASSESSED.
Do not score typed spellings as speech.
pronunciation.goal: Practise the pronunciation target for this lesson.
pronunciation.instruction: Model the letter pairs A/E, G/J, and M/N one pair at a time. Ask the learner to repeat and then spell a short chosen name.

constraints: Do not request a full legal name.
Focus feedback on the target question and letter order.
speaking.goal: Practise the speaking target for this lesson.
speaking.instruction: Ask the learner's name, then ask How do you spell that? Wait after each question and confirm the letters in one short sentence.

constraints: Do not replace the learner's full draft.
Treat hyphenated letter sequences as acceptable.
writing.goal: Practise the writing target for this lesson.
writing.instruction: Ask the learner to write two lines: My name is ___. It is spelled ___. Wait for the draft and give one brief correction if needed.

title: Spell Your Name
